chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0579: Ji Ning Fights the Empyrean Tribulation
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning faces the Empyrean Tribulation. A tender moment with his daughter Brightmoon steels his Dao-heart as the Wind, Fire, and Thunder tribulations descend. The legendary Pure Yang Golden Light Thunder may be coming.
og_title: Ji Ning Makes a Promise, Then Faces a Cosmic Storm
og_description: After tragedy, Ji Ning comforts his daughter before triggering the Empyrean Tribulation. Patriarch Subhuti discusses a legendary thunder that could forge a perfect god-body.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 0579: The Empyrean Tribulation Begins
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s tender promise to Brightmoon grounds him as he faces the Wind, Fire, and Thunder trials of the Empyrean Tribulation. Pure Yang Golden Light Thunder is hinted!

lore_anchors.definition: The specific heavenly tribulation faced by Fiendgod Body Refiners to become an Empyrean God. It consists of Wind, Fire, and Thunder tribulations designed to forge a perfect, immortal divine body and is far more dangerous than the tribulation for Ki Refiners.
The supreme defensive divine ability practiced by Ji Ning. At the sixth cycle, his physical body is tough enough to passively endure most attacks, serving as a benchmark for his physical supremacy.
An exceedingly rare and ancient form of thunder from the primordial era. It is far more dangerous than standard tribulation thunder but can help forge a truly perfect Empyrean God body.
The number one Fiendgod Body Refining method in the Three Realms. Ji Ning breaks through to its Eighteenth Cycle in this chapter, triggering the Empyrean Tribulation.
Ji Ning's master from Mount Innerheart. He is a mysterious and powerful Primordial True God who watches over his disciples from the shadows.
A major world named by Ji Ning. It serves as a stage for the Empyrean Tribulation.
